title: Signal: Conan lock entry with no recipe revision
scope: A conan.lock file that declares a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix.
limitations: It matches a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix in the parsed conan.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A conan.lock that mentions a locked reference without a `#revision` suffix in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
